name: AH 5275
title: HAZWOPER
description: Provides individuals the necessary knowledge and training to meet the criteria for certification recognized by the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) in work activities related to hazardous waste sites and cleanup operations involving  hazardous substances. Optional field exercise. Only students who successfully complete both the academic and hands-on field exercise offered within this course will  receive a 40-hour HAZWOPER certificate.
requirement_description: Not open to students who have successfully completed AH 3275.
